The get_adsorption_sites_text tool expects a proper CIF with data block header like "data_..."? The original file started with "# generated using pymatgen\n_data_Cu2O". The tool gave error "Invalid CIF file with no structures!". Possibly need to include the full CIF including the data block header and maybe the "loop_" sections. The original file had that. The first attempt included "# generated using pymatgen\n_data_Cu2O..." which should be fine. Why error? Maybe the tool expects the CIF string without the leading comment line? Or expects a proper newline after data block? The error persists.

Maybe the tool expects the CIF to be a string of the file content exactly as read. The first attempt used the full content including "# generated using pymatgen\n_data_Cu2O". That should be okay. But maybe the tool cannot parse because of the leading comment line "# generated using pymatgen". Let's try without the comment line.

We'll read the file again to get exact content, then strip the first line if it starts with "#".
